shared_boundaries.CAPITAL_ADEQUACY_RATIO: No total CAR numeric fact qualified. Capital adequacy heading and Additional Tier 1 ratio must not be relabelled total CAR.
shared_boundaries.NIM_TTM: Annual interest earned/expense cells do not prove direct TTM NIM or exact average earning assets.
shared_boundaries.ROE_ANNUAL: No direct eligible annual ROE established; do not divide profit by current equity as average-equity ROE.
shared_boundaries.ADVANCES_GROWTH: Balance-sheet Advances does not independently prove gross advances. Need comparable current/prior period scope and approved growth contract.
shared_boundaries.DEPOSITS_GROWTH: One balance sheet deposit amount does not prove growth; need matching prior period and exact contract scope.
shared_boundaries.EPS_GROWTH: Annual/quarter EPS exists but prior-period comparison and share basis remain unqualified.
shared_boundaries.VALUATION: Current annual EPS does not qualify historical PIT EPS ledger.
